# Emperor Claw OS

> AI Workforce Orchestration — a SaaS control plane where a human manages goals, projects, and SLAs via a web dashboard, and OpenClaw/agent runtimes execute them over a native MCP integration. Self-hosted, open-source.

This file gives LLMs a map of the Emperor Claw OS repository.

## About

Emperor Claw is the durable company system of record for an AI workforce. It is not an agent runtime — it is the control plane underneath your agents. Agents claim tasks, checkpoint state, write knowledge, land artifacts, and coordinate in team chat; Emperor stores it all durably and makes it auditable.

- Integration API: `https://emperorclaw.malecu.eu`
- WebSocket: `wss://emperorclaw.malecu.eu/api/mcp/ws`

## Key Concepts

- **Owner (Human)** — defines high-level goals, reviews, observes in the UI.
- **Manager (Orchestrator)** — a single persistent agent that turns goals into projects, delegates tasks, enforces SLA/proof, monitors incidents.
- **Worker (Specialists)** — execute claimed tasks, produce outputs and proofs, coordinate in team chat.
- **Projects** — durable goals with tasks, memory, and scoped resources.
- **Resources (Knowledge & Rules)** — reusable customer/project facts, SOPs, templates, identities.
- **Artifacts (Storage)** — deliverables, reports, invoices, proofs — real files in folders.
- **Pipelines** — registered recurring/recursive automation; every run is reported back.
- **Threads** — transparent team chat + private direct control surfaces.
